official.domain-heading: GFTV gi zhungdrel sakhong tshu globalfurry.tv yangna gftv.asia gi jugdu wa in.
official.domain-body: Khajang di jug lä lhag go. Dangpai slash kyangpa gi hema yöpai thigcha thama lu ta. Zhen ci gi jugdu mi sakhong di GFTV men, ming di khajang gi hema ci nang thön rung.
official.trusted-link: GFTV gi zhungdrel sakhong tshu gi tho yongdzog
official.secure-heading: Nyensung cen gyi sakhong tshu gi HTTPS laklen thab in.
official.secure-body: Gochag kyi tag yangna khajang gi go lu https:// yöp lu ta. Ger gyi chathrin tshu nyensung cen gyi thüplam thog lä zhungdrel sakhong ci nang kyangma ci goshä kap.

update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot gi thönrim sarp dra drig yöp in.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot gi mingshog. Dzumchen ci gi bar lu Hello dang 哈喽 dri yöp, GFTV gi jatshön rimo gi gu lu in.
hero.title: Chö gi HelloSpot ci thob ci!
hero.lede: Furry gi dzom dang tshogchen tshu nang, HelloSpot zer mi di mi sarp tshu gi charo sarp zo sai sago in.
how.title: HelloSpot la be thang
how.spot.title: Dzum di tshöl
how.spot.body: Shogjang, changthag yangna dartag ci gu HelloSmile tshöl. Gate yö rung, de HelloSpot in.
how.hello.title: Kuzuzangpo lap
how.hello.body: Shog zhinmalä kuzuzangpo lap. HelloSpot nang chö gi dato lä rang mi ngoshe gop in zer mi ci gi yang reba mi kye.
how.friend.title: Charo zo
how.friend.body: Chö kyi tha khor nang gi mi tshu dang chä zhinmalä, shulmai dzom lu tshöl ni gi mi ci dang ci khar log jo.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) di Singapur lu zhitsug te yöpai Eshiya gi furry tshogpai nätshül nyendrin cheshö in.
about.body-2: Nga ce gi furry tshu gi yarphel di dari dang nangpa mi gara gi shetshor yö nii dön lu tönm in. Dele mi tshu gi ci gi ci gi kor lä lap te hago tshug nii sago tshu zo in.
about.body-3: Chim lä go zung lingchen tshu tshün khyap te yöpai GFTV gi detshen di gyelchi cen, lamsöl namang dang khakä namang cen in.
outro.title: Shulmai HelloSpot lu chä ge!
